actual_generation_provenance.actual_prompt:
Edit the supplied S3-01 warm-white, graphite and vermilion technical concept illustration. This is a focused whole-image editing task, not a new architecture design.

Make exactly this editorial change: remove the entire large top title ‘同一程序 · 独立模型 · 架构比较’ AND remove the long black horizontal rule immediately underneath that title. The report will supply its own external figure caption, so do not replace the removed header with any new title, subtitle, label, logo or rule. Fill the removed area naturally with the same clean near-white warm background. Rebalance only the empty outer margins if needed so the diagram feels compact and centered; retain the relative arrangement and the large lettering of the actual diagram. Do not shrink its content, clip the canvas, or create a collage. Produce a clean native edited illustration.

PRESERVE the functional diagram and every remaining word: the left two-line common input ‘同一 AM 镜像’ / ‘程序与初始数据’; its split into two independent input arrows; the identical gray RTL and NEMU rectangles; the labels ‘RTL’ / ‘硬件并行归约’ and ‘NEMU’ / ‘软件顺序求和’; the two independent right-pointing output arrows; the single vermilion vertical boundary and ‘架构提交边界’ label; the ‘DiffTest’ heading and its short vermilion underline; the three comparison rows ‘完整向量结果’, ‘向量 CSR’, ‘异常状态’; the final ‘一致性判定 / 差异定位’ label. Keep the two models equal in size, fill and visual weight. Keep the architectural comparison meaning, not cycle-level lockstep. Keep dark text, warm neutral fill and restrained vermilion.

Do not add concepts, numbers, bits, data, waveform shapes, processor icons, modules, extra arrows or any PASS claim. Do not change or paraphrase remaining labels. Do not connect RTL and NEMU to one another. All label sizes must remain as large and readable as in the source at 160mm report width. Preserve the professional flat technical style and crisp simplified Chinese text. The only substantial content removal is the top overall title and the long black rule beneath it.
actual_generation_provenance.note: Focused edit of warm S3-01 v1 per main task seq1275, under authenticated human all-figure redesign authorization; removed top overall title and black long rule. Generated once, no pixel compositing, no technical simulation.

review.reviewer: pro1-visual-reviewer; independent actual-image review by native stage1_evidence
review.acceptance_criterion: Focused whole-image edit: remove the top overall title and long black rule; preserve all remaining labels, relative functional relationships and large report-readable lettering. Acceptance is for main-Pro sample comparison, not human approval of the whole set.
review.evidence: Actual output inspected. Top title and long black rule are absent. Common AM input still forks into equal RTL and NEMU rectangles; independent output arrows, vermilion architectural boundary, DiffTest heading and short underline, complete-vector/CSR/exception rows and consistency/difference purpose all remain visible without altered wording. Independent reviewer viewed parent and edited image and reported no blocking semantic or label change.
review.limitations: Visual preservation only; pixel identity and exact raster font point sizes were not asserted. Canvas changes from1586x992 to1585x992. Removed header leaves generous top background space, retained rather than cropped. No simulation or hardware verification was executed. Human has not selected a final style for all22 figures.

scope: Candidate concept illustration only; report supplies an external caption. No title/long rule within the image. Not a measured waveform or exact circuit schematic.
technical_caption_recommendation: 图中的并行归约与顺序求和描述VDot操作的两种独立实现；DiffTest在架构提交对应关系下比较完整128位向量结果及相关状态，不表示内部逐周期锁步。
